dialogue.text: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.
dialogue.ja: 啓蟄、雷が鳴ってすべての生き物を目覚めさせる。
dialogue.local: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.
dialogue.en: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.

dialogue.text: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.
dialogue.zh: 大約在三月六日，春天的第一聲雷響遍天空。
dialogue.ja: 3月6日頃、春の最初の雷が空に轟く。
dialogue.local: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.
dialogue.en: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.

dialogue.text: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.
dialogue.ja: これが啓蟄、虫が目覚める時節だ。
dialogue.local: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.
dialogue.en: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.

dialogue.text: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.
dialogue.zh: 整個冬天，昆蟲、青蛙和蛇都在地下冬眠。
dialogue.ja: 冬の間、虫やカエル、ヘビは地中で眠っている。
dialogue.local: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.
dialogue.en: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.

dialogue.text: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.
dialogue.ja: 雷は大きな目覚まし時計のようだ。
dialogue.local: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.
dialogue.en: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.

dialogue.text: Boom, wake up, spring is here.
dialogue.ja: ドーン、起きて、春が来たよ。
dialogue.local: Boom, wake up, spring is here.
dialogue.en: Boom, wake up, spring is here.

dialogue.text: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.
dialogue.zh: 昆蟲爬出來，青蛙開始呱呱叫。
dialogue.ja: 虫たちが這い出し、カエルが鳴き始める。
dialogue.local: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.
dialogue.en: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.

dialogue.text: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.
dialogue.zh: 桃花開始綻放，粉紅又美麗。
dialogue.ja: 桃の花がピンク色に美しく咲き始める。
dialogue.local: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.
dialogue.en: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.

dialogue.text: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
dialogue.zh: 大自然的鬧鐘響起，整個世界甦醒。
dialogue.ja: 自然の目覚まし時計が鳴り、世界中が目を覚ます。
dialogue.local: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
dialogue.en: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
